_comment: NO SECRETS are committed here. SchoolContext/LabReadOnlyContext authenticate to Azure SQL Managed Instance using Managed Identity (passwordless, 'Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity'): no SQL username/password is ever stored. The placeholders below (<SQLMI_SERVER_FQDN>, <UAMI_CLIENT_ID>) MUST be overridden at deployment time via environment variables (ConnectionStrings__SchoolContext / ConnectionStrings__LabReadOnlyContext) or an environment-specific appsettings.{Environment}.json — never commit real server names or identity client ids here.
